# Recorded-frame fixtures

Each fixture is a pair of files with the same stem:

* `<name>.log` — CAN frames in `candump -l` format
  (`(epoch.micro) iface ID#HEX`), written on the bench by
  `tools/naviq_mts160_fixture/record.py` from the driver's `~/raw` topic
  (or directly from the gs_usb bus in fallback mode).
* `<name>.json` — ground truth and expectations:

```json
{
  "description": "trunk tape, single-tape section, yaw 0, sensor centred",
  "node_id": 10,
  "recorded": "2026-09-24T10:12:00",
  "source": "bench WSL2 gs_usb via usbipd; printer M114 after M400",
  "segments": [
    {
      "name": "centred",
      "t_start": 0.0,              "t_end": 2.0,            // seconds from first frame
      "printer": {"x": 220.0, "y": 150.3, "z": 20.0, "e": 0.0, "yaw_deg": 0.0},
      "truth":   {"offset_mm": 0.0, "incidence_deg": 0.0},
      "expect": {
        "strength":          {"min": 2},                       // int compare on every TPDO1
        "left_position_mm":  {"mean": 0.0, "tol": 1.0},        // mean over the segment
        "right_position_mm": {"mean": 0.0, "tol": 1.0},
        "left_angle_deg":    {"mean": 0.0, "tol": 1.0},
        "single_track":      {"fraction_true_min": 0.95},
        "fork":              {"fraction_true_max": 0.0},
        "navicode_counter_changes": 0,                         // over the segment (TPDO3)
        "tpdo1_rate_hz":     {"min": 90, "max": 110}
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`test_replay.py` runs every pair through the decoder and, when possible,
through the live driver node (python-can `virtual` in-process; `vcan0` via
socketcan when the interface exists, e.g. in CI).  Tolerances are the ones
from the spec's §8.

Fixtures are added by the bench sessions; `synthetic_*.log` files are
generated by the tests themselves (they must not be committed).
